import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import vm from 'node:vm';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import {createHash, webcrypto} from 'node:crypto';

// This tests the generated bridge's boundary with deterministic event fixtures.
// It is not native-browser proof of isTrusted, Client IDs or incumbent callers.
const artifact = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8');
const marker = 'const ScriptTemplate = `';
let script = artifact.slice(artifact.indexOf(marker) + marker.length, artifact.lastIndexOf('`'));
const hash = value => createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');
const origin = 'https://example.test', docURL = origin + '/guide', body = 'worker';
const assetURL = docURL + '/_nextgo/' + 'a'.repeat(20) + '/worker-' + hash(body) + '.wasm';
const catalog = {
  Config: {Origin: origin, BasePath: '/guide', Budget: {InFlight: 4, Queue: 4}},
  Assets: [{URL: assetURL, Kind: 'worker-wasm', SHA256: hash(body), DecodedBytes: body.length, ContentType: 'application/wasm'}],
  Documents: [{Path: '/'}],
};
const catalogJSON = JSON.stringify(catalog);
const descriptor = {
  namespace: 'nextgo-offline-v1-' + 'a'.repeat(64), generation: 'b'.repeat(64), catalogJSON, catalogSHA256: hash(catalogJSON),
  client: {scope: docURL, workerURL: docURL + '/_nextgo/offline/sw.js', catalogURL: docURL + '/_nextgo/offline/catalog'},
};
script = script.replace('__NEXTGO_OFFLINE_SHIM__', '').replace('__NEXTGO_OFFLINE_DESCRIPTOR__', JSON.stringify(descriptor));
const handlers = new Map(), dispatches = [], resumes = [], clientReads = [];
let context, boots = 0;
const self = {
  location: {href: descriptor.client.workerURL}, registration: {active: null},
  clients: {async matchAll(options) {
    clientReads.push({...options});
    return options.includeUncontrolled ? [{id: 'parent'}, {id: 'helper'}, {id: 'uncontrolled'}] : [{id: 'parent'}, {id: 'helper'}];
  }},
  addEventListener(name, callback) { handlers.set(name, callback); },
};
class Go {
  constructor() { boots++; this.env = {}; this.importObject = {}; }
  run() {
    context.__nextgoOfflineBridge.register((kind, token, payload, source) => {
      dispatches.push({kind, payload: JSON.parse(payload), source});
      Promise.resolve().then(() => context.__nextgoOfflineBridge.finish(token, '{"fixture":true}'));
      return true;
    }, (...args) => resumes.push(args));
    return new Promise(() => {});
  }
}
context = vm.createContext({
  self, navigator: {locks: {async request(_name, _options, callback) { return callback(); }}},
  caches: {async keys() { return [descriptor.namespace + '-g-' + descriptor.generation]; }, async open() { return {async match(url) { return url === assetURL ? new Response(body, {headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/wasm'}}) : undefined; }}; }},
  crypto: webcrypto, Go, WebAssembly: {async instantiate() { return {instance: {}}; }},
  Request, Response, Headers, ReadableStream, TextEncoder, TextDecoder, AbortController, MessageChannel, setTimeout, clearTimeout,
  async fetch() { throw Error('cached fixture must not fetch'); },
});
vm.runInContext(script, context);
function event(overrides = {}) {
  const port = {messages: [], closes: 0, postMessage(value) { this.messages.push(value); }, close() { this.closes++; }};
  const jobs = [];
  const value = {isTrusted: true, data: {version: 1, command: 'disable-recovered', requestID: 'request-1'}, source: {type: 'window', url: docURL, id: 'parent'}, ports: [port], waitUntil(promise) { jobs.push(promise); }, ...overrides};
  return {value, jobs, port};
}
for (const overrides of [
  {isTrusted: false}, {isTrusted: undefined},
  {source: {type: 'window', url: docURL}},
  {source: {type: 'window', url: docURL, id: ''}},
  {source: {type: 'window', url: docURL, id: 'bad id'}},
  {source: {type: 'window', url: docURL, id: 'x'.repeat(65)}},
  {source: {type: 'serviceworker', url: docURL, id: 'parent'}},
  {source: {type: 'window', url: docURL + '/' + 'é'.repeat(1024), id: 'parent'}},
]) {
  const current = event(overrides);
  handlers.get('message')(current.value);
  assert.equal(current.jobs.length, 0, 'invalid recovery source must refuse before event admission/boot');
}
assert.equal(boots, 0); assert.equal(dispatches.length, 0);
const native = event(); handlers.get('message')(native.value);
assert.equal(native.jobs.length, 1); await Promise.all(native.jobs);
assert.equal(boots, 1); assert.equal(native.port.closes, 1); assert.equal(native.port.messages.length, 1);
assert.equal(dispatches[0].kind, 'message-disable-recovered');
assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(dispatches[0].source), {url: docURL, id: 'parent'});
assert.equal('id' in dispatches[0].payload, false, 'native ID must stay outside authored command');
// A forged payload cannot replace the native context. The Go closed Command
// decoder separately rejects this extra clientID field (native Go test).
const forged = event({data: {version: 1, command: 'disable-recovered', requestID: 'request-2', clientID: 'forged'}});
handlers.get('message')(forged.value); await Promise.all(forged.jobs);
assert.equal(JSON.parse(dispatches[1].source).id, 'parent'); assert.equal(dispatches[1].payload.clientID, 'forged');
// Existing status/enable/disable use their unchanged URL-only source contract.
for (const command of ['status', 'enable', 'disable']) {
  const legacy = event({isTrusted: undefined, source: {type: 'window', url: docURL}, data: {version: 1, command}});
  handlers.get('message')(legacy.value); await Promise.all(legacy.jobs);
  assert.equal(dispatches.at(-1).kind, 'message'); assert.equal(dispatches.at(-1).source, docURL);
}
context.__nextgoOfflineBridge.perform('clients-pair', 'clients', '{}');
for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !resumes.length; i++) await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1));
assert.equal(resumes.length, 1); assert.equal(resumes[0][0], 'clients-pair'); assert.equal(resumes[0][2], true);
assert.deepEqual(clientReads, [{type: 'window', includeUncontrolled: false}, {type: 'window', includeUncontrolled: true}]);
assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(resumes[0][1]), {controlled: 2, clientIDs: ['parent', 'helper'], visibleIDs: ['parent', 'helper', 'uncontrolled']});
console.log('recovered native-context dispatch and unchanged sequential clients pair verified');
